Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.

As a Senior Statistician, you’ll work within a cross-functional team alongside other analysts, data-scientists, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in generating actionable insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Take ownership and evolve our existing program impact measurement capabilities, built in-house and in partnership with third-party experts such as IQVIA.

• Develop and maintain  analytically rigorous program performance benchmarks.

• Discuss standard and bespoke measurement methodologies with clients during pre-sale and present analysis results to brand marketing team as well as client analytics team

• Mentor and help Business Analytics Managers with interpreting measurement results, identifying actionable insights and preparing for client discussions leading to increased sale and renewals

• Serve as statistical consultant and provide guidance to Data-Science team for advanced modeling

• Help implement and scale survey /  market research based measurement capabilities 

• Manage vendor relationships for third party data procurement.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

• Collaboration—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

• Passion for Data—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

• Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

• Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

• Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you:

• 10+ years of professional experience in a quantitative or statistical role (e.g., statistician, biostatistician), within healthcare, pharma, or a related industry.

• Hands on experience with statistical methodologies and techniques such as test-vs-control study designs, covariate adjustment methods (e.g., ANCOVA), clustering, etc.

• Strong context into HCP prescription and claims data, including how they're recorded and tracked by data vendors, what they represent, and typical data gaps.

• Advanced SQL and python proficiency including writing complex queries across multiple tables and familiarity with data science libraries

• Experience working with third party analytics vendors such as IQVIA, including running independent studies, engaging in RFPs and contract discussions, and maintaining relationships.

• Experience applying data science techniques such as clustering and machine learning to sponsored engagement, using Rx and Dx data to measure impact.

• Experience representing yourself externally and leading client conversations around program performance analysis.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team

• We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

• Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

• The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

• We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $151,000 - $207,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include:

• Base salary

• Equity (where applicable)

• Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Flexible paid time off and company holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Professional development and learning opportunities

• Wellness and mental health resources

• Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

• Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

• Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

• Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

• Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

• Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

391a0df59913aea5.description: **About Metaforms** At Metaforms, we're redefining how market research gets done. Our AI platform empowers the world's leading research agencies to scale 10x faster without compromising on quality. With AI Agents augmenting survey programming, data processing, and project management, we help customers like Dynata, Savanta, and Borderless Access deliver more projects with less effort. - **1,000+ surveys** processed on our platform every month - Trusted by agencies serving **Fortune 500 companies** - **Rapid month-over-month growth** across customers and volume - **$9M Series A** raised to aggressively scale the team and product **The Role** We're hiring a **QA Engineer** to own the reliability, accuracy, and quality of our AI-powered research automation products. QA at Metaforms is a different problem from testing standard SaaS. Our platform generates surveys, processes research data, and automates workflows where a subtle logic error can create real downstream cost for an agency and its clients. Output isn't always deterministic, edge cases hide in survey logic and data handoffs, and "looks fine" isn't the same as "correct." You'll be the gatekeeper between QA and production — designing test plans, hunting edge cases, validating fixes, and running end-to-end checks on critical components so that every release ships clean. Your judgment on what to test, and how deeply, directly shapes the trust our customers place in the product. **What You'll Do** *Test Design & Execution* - Design and maintain manual test plans for product features and workflows across the platform - Identify edge cases and boundary values others miss, and translate them into detailed, reusable test cases - Perform functional and regression testing for tickets, bug fixes, and enhancements - Conduct end-to-end testing of critical components during QA → Production release cycles *Quality Operations* - Manually verify failed cases from automation test runs and separate real defects from flaky tests - Document and track defects with clear, reliable reproduction steps that engineering can act on immediately - Contribute to release sign-off decisions — knowing when something is ready to ship, and when it isn't *Collaboration* - Work closely with product, engineering, and automation QA teams to keep release cycles fast and smooth - Feed recurring defect patterns back into the team so quality improves upstream, not just at the gate **What We're Looking For** *Must-have* - **2–4 years of QA / software testing experience**, ideally on web-based products - Strong command of test case design, regression testing, and release validation - Hands-on experience with bug tracking and test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, or similar) - Critical thinking and genuine curiosity about how things break — you find the edge cases specs don't mention - Sharp attention to detail and high standards for what "done" means - Clear written communication — your bug reports and test documentation should need no follow-up questions *Nice-to-have* - Experience testing SaaS or AI products, especially where outputs are non-deterministic - Exposure to automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) or interest in growing into automation - Familiarity with market research or survey programming workflows - Basic SQL or API testing skills (Postman or similar) **Why Join Metaforms** - **Shape quality standards** for AI-driven products at the frontier of research automation — a genuinely harder and more interesting QA problem than typical SaaS - Work with a high-agency, motivated team of engineers, product thinkers, and designers - **Zero bureaucracy** — your findings drive decisions, and releases don't move without your sign-off - Join a **Series A funded company** at the steepest part of its growth curve **Benefits** - Full family health insurance - $1,000 USD annual reimbursement for skill development - Dedicated mentor/coach support - Free lunch and dinner at the office - Monthly food and snacks allowance

Job Description

Manager, Corporate Finance & FP&A

Location - Hyderabad, India

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and results-oriented Manager, Corporate Finance & FP&A to lead enterprise-wide financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting, and strategic financial analysis. This role will own critical planning processes including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Strategic Business Plan (SBP), quarterly forecasts, and executive reporting while providing leadership for integrated 3-statement financial modelling.

The role serves as a key finance partner to executive leadership and plays a pivotal role in quarterly Board of Directors (BoD) reporting, earnings call preparation, and investor-related financial analysis. The successful candidate will combine strong financial expertise, executive communication skills, and leadership capabilities to drive business performance, enhance forecasting accuracy, and support strategic decision-making.

This position requires a proven leader who can influence across a matrixed organization, develop high-performing teams, and drive continuous improvements in financial planning and reporting processes.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead enterprise-wide planning processes including AOP, SBP, long-range planning, and quarterly forecasts.
• Develop accurate financial forecasts, scenario analyses, and strategic recommendations to support business objectives.
• Own and enhance integrated Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting models.
• Drive monthly, quarterly, and annual financial performance reviews, highlighting key trends, risks, opportunities, and business drivers.
• Prepare executive presentations, Board materials, KPI dashboards, and financial narratives for leadership reviews.
• Partner closely with business leaders, Accounting, Investor Relations, Operations, and Corporate Finance teams to support strategic initiatives and business decision-making.
• Lead enterprise-wide Risk & Opportunities assessments and develop mitigation strategies to improve forecast accuracy.
• Identify opportunities to improve profitability, productivity, cash flow, and operational performance through data-driven insights.
• Drive FP&A transformation initiatives, including automation, reporting enhancements, driver-based forecasting, and process standardization.
• Lead, coach, and develop a team of 7-8 finance professionals, fostering a high-performance and collaborative culture.

Qualifications

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; CPA, CA, or CFA preferred.
• 11+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Finance, FP&A, Strategic Finance, or related disciplines.
• Strong expertise in financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and integrated 3-statement financial modelling.
• Proven experience supporting executive leadership, Board of Directors reporting, and earnings-related financial analysis.
• Demonstrated ability to translate complex financial data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
• Experience operating in a large, matrixed, and fast-paced organization.

Preferred Technical Skills

• Hyperion Planning & Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS)
• Oracle ERP and financial systems
• Advanced Excel financial modelling
• Financial reporting, analytics, and visualization tools

Why Join Us

• Strategic Impact: You will own the income statement and 3-statement modeling processes, driving financial excellence and business insights.
• Process Transformation: You will contribute to modernizing our financial planning processes, implementing driver-based forecasting, and improving financial reporting and analysis
• Leadership Exposure: Your work will directly impact key deliverables presented to senior leadership, board of directors, and investors.
• Professional Growth: You will lead and develop a team of high-performing financial analysts, while gaining deep exposure to corporate strategy and financial planning.

An overview of this role

As Senior Manager, Total Rewards Operations, India, you'll lead a small team supporting GitLab's global benefits and compensation operations. You'll translate global program priorities into dependable execution, strengthen operational controls, and make processes easier to run and support across regions and time zones. You'll set clear priorities and quality standards while coaching your team to deliver accurate work. You'll support global programs in partnership with their functional owners, rather than set enterprise-wide compensation or benefits strategy.

What You’ll Do  

  • Oversee, coach, and develop the day-to-day responsibilities for the local Benefits Analyst and Senior Total Rewards Operations Analyst, establishing clear ownership, goals, feedback practices, and coverage plans.
  • Prioritize global benefits support and compensation operations work, balancing recurring cycles, service requests, audits, and time-sensitive projects.
  • Oversee compensation operations support, including market-data workflows, compensation-cycle preparation, system transactions, equity grant data checks, and audit evidence.
  • Establish quality controls, review points, escalation paths, and records practices that protect sensitive compensation and benefits information and maintain appropriate access and confidentiality.
  • Monitor deadlines, dependencies, service trends, and risks, surfacing issues early and carrying practical process improvements through to adoption.
  • Partner with global program owners to coordinate execution across geographies, communicate local considerations, and support consistent team member experiences through clear written updates, decision records, and reusable documentation.
  • Work with People Technology and system stakeholders to clarify requirements, test process and system changes, and improve data quality and workflow efficiency, using artificial intelligence tools responsibly where appropriate.

What You’ll Bring 

  • Experience in Total Rewards, benefits, compensation operations, or a closely related People function in a global organization, with working knowledge of benefits administration and/or compensation processes and their dependencies.
  • Demonstrated people-management ability, including setting priorities, coaching team members, and developing operational capability.
  • A record of delivering accurate work across multiple deadlines, stakeholders, and time zones, supported by practical controls, root-cause analysis, and process improvements.
  • Clear written communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain processes and escalate risks.
  • Sound judgment with confidential data and sensitive team member matters.
  • Ability to use spreadsheets, human resources systems, and collaboration tools to manage workflows and validate data.
  • Fluency in artificial intelligence tools and the ability to use them responsibly to improve Total Rewards work and team processes.
  • Helpful, but not required: experience supporting a distributed, multi-country workforce or working with benefits vendors, brokers, salary surveys, equity grant operations, or compensation review cycles.

About the team

The Senior Total Rewards Operations Manager supports global total rewards programs, working with Payroll, Finance, People Operations, People Technology, Legal, People Business Partners, brokers, and vendors. The team's tools include Workday, Google Workspace, Slack, and Claude. The role emphasizes accurate administration, team-member support, and practical process improvements, with opportunities to build deeper total rewards expertise.

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.
Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.
As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.
Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work
• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• 
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
• 
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

You'll own API and model launches end to end, from positioning and messaging to docs, demos, sample code, and launch-day execution. • 
Experience in product marketing, product, or growth for developer tools, APIs, or infrastructure products, with a track record of leading high-impact launches

Technical enough to build with our APIs, read the docs critically, and go deep with researchers and engineers on what makes a model or feature different

Deep empathy for developers, with an instinct for what earns their attention and trust (and what makes them tune out)

Sharp, clear writer who can turn complex technical capabilities into positioning and messaging that resonates with builders

Self-starter with strong ownership, a bias toward action, and a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.
You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

•

Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

• 
Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.
• 
Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.
• 
Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

• 
An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
• 
Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• 
Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.
• 
Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.
• 
Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.
• 
Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.
